name: ml-selection-benchmark-data
description: Dataset intended for research on automated model-selection and meta-learning: it pairs dataset/meta-features with labels indicating preferred models or configurations. It is used to train and evaluate systems that predict or rank which ML model or pipeline will perform best for a given dataset. Useful for AutoML, meta-learning, and algorithm recommendation experiments.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited visibility and adoption; primarily used in small-scale or repository-specific experiments.
